name: pagination-48
description: Photo lightbox with pagination overlaid on the media and an image counter.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { ChevronLeftIcon, ChevronRightIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Pagination, PaginationContent, PaginationItem, PaginationLink, } from "@workspace/ui/components/pagination" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const shots = [ { title: "Dune ridge at dawn", tone: "from-orange-300 via-rose-300 to-purple-400", }, { title: "Glacier lagoon", tone: "from-cyan-200 via-sky-300 to-blue-500" }, { title: "Pine valley", tone: "from-emerald-300 via-green-400 to-teal-600" }, { title: "Desert bloom", tone: "from-yellow-200 via-amber-300 to-orange-400", }, ] export default function LightboxOverlayPagination() { const [index, setIndex] = React.useState(0) const shot = shots[index]! return (
{shot.title} {index + 1} of {shots.length}
{ event.preventDefault() setIndex((i) => (i - 1 + shots.length) % shots.length) }} > { event.preventDefault() setIndex((i) => (i + 1) % shots.length) }} >
) }
